title: fix(tasks): avoid false maintenance warnings during restart
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes misleading task-registry maintenance failure warnings when restart drain refuses a scheduled sweep before it starts.

## User Impact

Expected admission refusals no longer produce failure warnings. Errors from sweeps that already started remain visible, including storage failures and typed drain errors while stopping.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the scheduler's existing admission fact with the canonical restart-drain classifier. Pending-admission cancellation and sweep settlement keep their existing behavior.

The change adds four net production lines at the admission boundary and 95 lines of regression tests. The PR remains limited to the scheduler and its regression test.

## Evidence

- Signed integrated head `12dc320e6794d9b825d8366a603cc72ad729accd` extends `2da5da375ed5917ddaeefae586aba01c07e0bc4c` with frozen main `3d4033fbe0aca10c9eec45a7c088540607181d79`. Both authored files remain byte-for-byte identical, and task/admission owners are unchanged from the earlier integrated baseline. Full-range autoreview and independent source review found no actionable P0–P2 issues; diff/privacy checks pass.
- The [previous hosted run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35638246452) passed the canonical MCP approval fixture but exposed three other approval-readiness failures and two unhandled observer closures. The shared fixture/request-lifetime repair landed separately in [#155111](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/155111), [ff26aaef](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ff26aaefcd6780f5d2781539d7b2888bff2ef608), and is included in the frozen main revision. This PR retains its original two-file scheduler scope. The previous accepted auto request was confirmed cancelled through the native retained-outcome recovery before the head update.
- Current `12dc320e6794d9b825d8366a603cc72ad729accd` standalone proof: `pnpm test src/tasks/task-registry-maintenance-scheduler.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passed **5/5 in 3.184 seconds of full command wall time** (Vitest 1.58s; wrapper 2.83s; summed printed case times 0.116s). Node 24.19.0/pnpm 12.4.0; install and allocation excluded. All six source/dependency input hashes matched before and after; command/native exit 0. [Focused Testbox run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35650092757) was disposed successfully; backing Actions lifecycle cancellation after disposal is not a test failure.
- [Current hosted CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35649996720) tests merge `5c0304c60d994c2eb23771ddc448b062873851ab`, whose second parent is exact `12dc320e6794d9b825d8366a603cc72ad729accd`. Attempt 1 completed successfully: 130 jobs passed and 17 were intentionally skipped. The required Actions check passed at 20:38:07 UTC; the separate combined commit status passed at 20:46:37 UTC through [Security Review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35652310143). Native preparation completed with exact-head hosted evidence, and its verified/prepared heads both match this commit. Earlier proof below is historical evidence for unchanged authored files.
- [Current-head ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/154932#issuecomment-5763360944), revision 6, reviewed this exact head at 20:58:24 UTC and was published at 20:59:28 UTC. Findings, Security, and Before merge are all None; no rank-up moves remain. Its earlier publication delay is resolved. The review correctly treats the five scheduler cases as boundary coverage, not a live Gateway restart demonstration.
- Previous `2da5da375ed5917ddaeefae586aba01c07e0bc4c` standalone proof: `pnpm test src/tasks/task-registry-maintenance-scheduler.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passed all five tests in **3.782 seconds of full command wall time**, measured around the complete command (Vitest 2.26s; wrapper 3.29s). Node 24.19.0/pnpm 12.4.0; install and lease setup excluded. Exact head and all six source/dependency input hashes matched before and after. [Previous integrated-head focused proof run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35638268983): native command exit 0, one-shot Testbox stopped after success; its backing Actions lifecycle may show cancellation after disposal.
- Original `b7f0c6c` standalone test cost: `pnpm test src/tasks/task-registry-maintenance-scheduler.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passed all five tests in 2.824 seconds of full command wall time, including wrapper startup (Node 24.19.0, pnpm 12.4.0). Install and lease setup are excluded; source and frozen dependency hashes matched before and after. [Original focused proof run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35628532381).
- Frozen-baseline regression: both restart-refusal cases fail, including a refusal after suspension; the other three cases pass. Original candidate: all five regression cases and all four existing maintenance-scheduling tests pass.
- Original selected proof completed all 31 checks, including core types, all 25 core-test typecheck shards with concurrency 2, scoped formatting/lint, and storage/import/auth guards. The full typecheck remained applicable across a reviewed test-only removal of an explicit default `void` type argument; tests, formatting and scoped lint were rerun on the final authored files.
- Original remote proof used Node 24.19.0 and pnpm 12.4.0 against base `8df13399d71d1078508958822e36576dc2f2d23a` on [Blacksmith Testbox](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35610026678). It is retained as unchanged-file regression evidence, not a substitute for the integrated head's CI.
